jobs.description: Job Title: Computational Scenario & Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d) – Real Estate Optimization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-ALGO-05 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts scientific and applied research into algorithmic decision-making, automated site feasibility, and sustainable structural optimization. We combine spatial constraints, regulatory boundaries, and construction metrics to computationally model future-proof development scenarios. Role Overview As a Computational Algorithm Engineer, you will develop mathematical models and algorithmic scripts that simulate alternative building layouts, floor area ratios (BGF/BRI), and economic optimization scenarios for land parcels. Key Responsibilities - Develop computational logic to simulate building massing, setback constraints, and maximum buildable volumes based on parcel geometries. - Build mathematical evaluation models for multivariate scenario comparisons (e.g., Best-Case vs. Middle-Case commercial vs. mixed-use developments). - Interlink spatial building volumes with structured construction cost indices (German DIN 276 cost groups) to generate dynamic cost models. - Create parameter scripts and automated reporting outputs for feasibility analysis. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers, data engineers, and research directors. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree in Computational Design, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Engineering, or Architecture with an intensive programming focus. - Strong proficiency in Python, C#, or TypeScript; familiarity with computational geometry libraries or parametric modeling (Grasshopper/Rhino.Compute) is highly advantageous. - Solid mathematical foundations in optimization algorithms, geometry processing, and multivariate numerical analysis. - Ability to translate architectural planning regulations into structured code constraints. - Fluent written and verbal communication in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Compensation: Top-tier local remuneration reflecting algorithmic and computational expertise. - Modern Work Hub: Reliable, modern, air-conditioned workspace in DHA Karachi with high-speed fiber infrastructure and power backup. - Sustainable Career Track: Clear promotion tracks into Algorithm Lead or Scientific Computing Lead in Karachi, with ongoing exposure to European construction standards, research publications, and advanced modeling systems. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Outstanding candidates demonstrating mathematical rigor and successful delivery over 3–6 months can qualify for direct transfer to Germany as a Research Associate under § 18d AufenthG, including dedicated administrative assistance, visa handling, and housing / accommodation support on-site. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-ai@iris-institut.info

jobs.description: Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

Job Title: Data Extraction & Pipeline Engineer (m/f/d) – Web Scraping & Market Intelligence Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-DATA-04 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit develops intelligent data systems to observe, evaluate, and forecast market and sustainability developments across Europe. Our data pipelines extract and synthesize complex public, municipal, and real estate market indices into unified analytical models. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Backend & Data Extraction Engineer to design, deploy, and monitor scalable web crawlers, data scrapers, and data ingestion pipelines handling diverse, unstructured web sources. Key Responsibilities - Architect and maintain robust scraping and crawling pipelines targeting property portals, public registers, municipal gazettes, and economic data sources. - Implement parsing, data normalization, deduplication, and quality-validation routines for incoming raw data. - Manage proxy rotation, anti-bot mechanisms, rate limiting, and headless browser workflows. - Store and organize structured information using PostgreSQL, Redis, and document stores. - Package data services into Docker containers and interface them with internal analytics engines via REST/GraphQL APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology (e.g., FAST-NUCES, NED University, or equivalent). - Hands-on experience developing web scraping frameworks in Python: Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, or Puppeteer. - Practical knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/caching databases (Redis, MongoDB). - Experience with Linux environments, Docker, and Git. - Structured problem-solving mindset, persistence with complex web structures, and solid English skills. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Package: Excellent compensation package aligned with regional developer salaries. - Modern Workspace: Air-conditioned, reliable office in DHA Phase 1/2 with generator backup. - Local Leadership Path: Opportunities to scale into Engineering Lead / Data Operations Manager as the Karachi hub grows, supported by ongoing technical mentorship and European project workflows. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Top-performing engineers with consistent code quality and reliability over 3–6 months can transition to our research development institute in Germany under the § 18d researcher framework, complete with full visa sponsorship, relocation assistance, and housing / accommodation support. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

Job Title: Geospatial & Remote Sensing Data Engineer (m/f/d) – Satellite Analytics Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-GEO-03 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit conducts research into sustainable land use, environmental resilience, and automated parcel due diligence. Our geospatial research unit develops automated analytical tools that leverage satellite imagery, open geodata, and topography models to assess real estate sites and environmental factors. Role Overview In this role, you will design and implement data pipelines to process multi-spectral satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEM), and municipal cadastral layers to evaluate site topography, ground sealing, and solar potential. Key Responsibilities - Build automated ETL pipelines to ingest and process satellite data (Copernicus/Sentinel, Landsat) and aerial imagery. - Process Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Elevation Models (DEM) to calculate slope, terrain contouring, and building heights. - Match spatial parcel boundaries (ALKIS/OpenStreetMap) with satellite feature extractions using spatial databases. - Develop algorithmic scripts for rooftop solar potential calculation and environmental risk mapping (e.g., heat islands, flood zones). - Maintain spatial databases and expose analysis results via structured REST APIs. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Surveying, GIS, Computer Science, or equivalent. - Strong programming skills in Python utilizing geospatial libraries: GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL/OGR, or PyProj. - Solid experience with QGIS and spatial relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). - Familiarity with satellite data platforms (Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Open Access Hub, or Sentinel Hub) is an advantage. - Good command of spoken and written English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary structure reflecting technical specialization. - Professional Equipment & Infrastructure: Modern workstation in DHA, Karachi, equipped with high-bandwidth connections and uninterrupted power supply. - Career Growth: Long-term advancement to Senior GIS Architect / Data Lead in Karachi, with access to collaborative international research projects, European geodata publications, and conference opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Candidates demonstrating outstanding analytical achievements over 3–6 months are eligible for our German research mobility track (§ 18d AufenthG), including dedicated relocation guidance and housing / accommodation support in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

Job Title: 3D Architectural Visualizer & Real Estate Rendering Specialist (m/f/d) Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-REND-02 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-REND-02 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is a German research institution operating at the intersection of architectural digitization, environmental resilience, and sustainable development. We combine engineering precision with visual storytelling to present sustainable development concepts, municipal renewal proposals, and investment pitches to decision-makers. Role Overview We are looking for a creative and technically skilled 3D Architectural Visualizer to translate 3D building models and mass studies into photorealistic imagery, architectural perspectives, and presentation-ready visual assets. Key Responsibilities - Produce photorealistic architectural exterior and interior renderings from BIM/CAD geometry (Revit, SketchUp, Rhino). - Set up realistic lighting, material texturing, vegetation, and context environments for urban and commercial real estate assets. - Create mass studies, conceptual 3D volumes, and interactive walkthroughs for project feasibility presentations. - Perform post-production image enhancements and color grading in Adobe Photoshop. - Collaborate closely with BIM modelers and research leads to accurately reflect structural design intent. Requirements & Qualifications - Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Visualization, 3D Design, Animation, or related field (e.g., Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture, DUET, or comparable). - Proficiency in industry-standard visualization software: 3ds Max, Blender, Unreal Engine, Lumion, or Corona / V-Ray. - Strong aesthetic sense for architectural composition, atmospheric lighting, and material detailing. - A portfolio showing realistic architectural renderings is required for consideration. - Professional working proficiency in English. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package matching market rates. - Infrastructure: High-performance rendering hardware and reliable, air-conditioned studio space in DHA. - In-Country Career Growth: Rapid progression to Senior Visualizer or Art Director within our growing studio, with continuous training in real-time engines and computational visualization tools. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): Exceptional performers proving dedication and high visual standard over 3–6 months can qualify for an international transfer to our research facilities in Germany (§ 18d AufenthG), fully supported with visa facilitation, relocation, and housing / accommodation support. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.info

jobs.description: At Mitel, you will have the opportunity to help businesses connect, collaborate and provide better experiences for our customers. You will deliver valuable contributions in creating business success within our global organization utilizing your unique attributes, skills and experience.Please take a moment to look over this opportunity and if interested, feel free to send us your application. If this is not the right opportunity for you, you can also sign up for Job Alerts by creating an account. This will give you a profile that you can use for all future applications, and you will be notified whenever a new position that matches your criteria becomes available.About Mitel:Mitel is a global market leader in business communications, powering more than two billion connections every day. With customers in over 100 countries, we help organizations modernize their communications, strengthen collaboration, and deliver exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on innovation, integrity, and empowering our people to do their best work. At Mitel, you’ll join a team that values trust, encourages fresh thinking, and embraces diverse perspectives to drive meaningful impact. jobs.employer_name: Deutsches Institut für Ernährungsforschung Stiftung des öffentl.Rechts
jobs.description: The German Institute of Human Nutrition Potsdam-Rehbruecke (DIfE) (https://www.dife.de/) is a member of the Leibniz Association. The institute’s mission is to conduct experimental and clinical research in the field of nutrition and health, with the aim of understanding the molecular basis of nutrition-dependent diseases, and of developing new strategies for treatment and prevention.The Department Molecular Physiology of Exercise and Nutrition (MPEN) (https://www.dife.de/forschung/abteilungen-und-forschungsgruppen/molekulare-physiologie-der-bewegung-und-ernaehrung/) is inviting applications for1 Doctoral Student (m/f/d)starting as soon as possible.Project descriptionThis project investigates the regulation and metabolic fate of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in the liver, with a particular focus on their role in metabolic health and fatty liver disease. Using mouse models, cell culture systems, and state-of-the-art metabolic approaches, we aim to understand the mechanisms governing hepatic SCFA uptake and how these processes are regulated by nutritional states, including fasting and feeding, and altered under pathological conditions such as metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). A central focus of the project is to determine the intracellular fate of SCFAs, investigating when they serve as energy substrates, building blocks for anabolic processes, or regulators of gene expression through epigenetic modifications. By combining in vivo and in vitro experiments with stable isotope tracing and metabolic flux analysis, we aim to uncover how hepatic SCFA metabolism is regulated and how it contributes to liver function and metabolic disease.Specifically, the candidate will:- Plan and perform in vivo metabolic experiments in mice to investigate hepatic SCFA uptake, metabolism, and substrate utilization under different nutritional and disease conditions.- Design and conduct stable isotope tracing experiments, both in vivo and in cultured cells, to characterize SCFA uptake, intracellular metabolic fluxes, and incorporation into downstream metabolites and cellular components.- Establish and perform cell culture experiments, including work with primary hepatocytes, to investigate the molecular mechanisms controlling SCFA metabolism.- Investigate the contribution of SCFAs to energy metabolism, anabolic pathways, and epigenetic modifications, including histone acylation.- Perform downstream molecular and biochemical analyses of tissues and biological samples, including metabolomics, protein analyses, and measurements of metabolic intermediates.- Contribute to the management and maintenance of mouse colonies, including breeding, genotyping, and experimental planning.Requirements and Skills- A master's degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, physiology, nutritional sciences, or a related discipline.- Prior hands-on experience with stable isotope tracing and metabolic flux analysis is a key requirement for this position.- A strong background in intermediary metabolism, particularly hepatic glucose, lipid, or fatty acid metabolism.- Practical experience with cell culture techniques and molecular and biochemical assays.- Experience with mass spectrometry-based metabolomics and the analysis of isotope labeling data is an advantage.- Strong analytical skills, scientific curiosity, and the ability to plan and conduct experiments independently.- Excellent communication skills in English and a collaborative approach to research.We offer:- Intensive scientific support, close collaboration with cooperating institutions and enrolment in a local PhD program- Excellent technical equipment, a wide range of experimental methods and a dynamic and interactive research environment- Remuneration according to TV-L, level 13 (65 %), plus annual special payment and company pension scheme- Family-friendly working conditions (certificate “audit berufundfamilie”)- Supporting of mobility with a jobticket for using the public transport- Easy accessibility by public transport or car (including free parking)- 30 days of vacation- Participation in the benefits program for employees („Corporate Benefits“)The advertised position is available for 3 years.We promote the employment of people with severe disabilities and are committed to equal opportunities for them. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration if they have the same qualifications.We look forward to your application!Please send your documents (cover letter explaining your motivation, CV, copies of degrees/certificates and references) as a single pdf-file before November 25th, 2026 via e-mail to jobs@dife.de.For further information please do not hesitate to contact:Prof. Dr. Maximilian KleinertHead of Department Molecular Physiology of Exercise and NutritionE-Mail: Maximilian.Kleinert@dife.deWe process your application documents for the purpose of carrying out the application procedure in accordance with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b) GDPR, Art. 88 GDPR. For more information on the collection, processing and use of personal data by the German Institute of Human Nutrition as part of the application process and your rights under data protection law, please contact the Department of Human Resources and Social Services (jobs@dife.de).
